generatedBy.description: kbd-runtime for authoritative replay projections; absent only during legacy shadow mode.

sourceRevision.description: Canonical event revision used to render this projection.

activePhase.description: Slug of the final active phase in path. phase remains the root compatibility slug.

status.description: Legacy lifecycle alias in runtime projections; shadow inputs may contain stage-like values.

lifecycle.description: Canonical run lifecycle, distinct from active stage.

stageId.description: Active canonical stage ID; null when no stage is active.

stageStatus.description: Active stage status, separate from run lifecycle.

nextChange.description: Next nonterminal change derived from canonical task state at sourceRevision.

nextTask.description: Next nonterminal task derived from canonical task state at sourceRevision.

outcomeFirst.description: Present and true only for a phase created with --outcome-first. Absent for every other phase.

outcome.description: One-line user outcome the outcome-first phase must prove.

lastEvidence.description: Last meaningful evidence for the outcome-first phase: the latest gate receipt, else the last completed task. Derived on every projection.

nextAuthorizedAction.description: Next action derived from canonical state for the outcome-first phase. It never grants authority; boundary runs still need their authorization.

blockedChanges.description: Blocked changes that resume did not select, with their blocked task titles.

exactNextCommand.description: Stored operator intent. It may be stale and must never select executable work.

parentPhase.description: Immediate parent slug; null for top-level phases.
